release_notes: The honest-landing-funnel release, plus real role enforcement. Landing→offer metrics (community report): with the stream default 'Offer selection: Before the click' every landing view was counted as an offer transition — LP clicks and LP CTR read ~100%, so the tracker showed transitions the affiliate network never saw. New honest counters (Real LP clicks / Real offer clicks / Real LP CTR) count only clicks whose offer transition (offer_at) is recorded, sit alongside the legacy columns everywhere (campaigns list, campaign report constructor, offers and landings pages), and a new 'LP Time' grouping buckets the landing→offer seconds into 0-3s/3-10s/10-30s/30-60s/60s+ bands — the 0-3s band is bot/double-click territory and explains most network mismatches. landing_at is now written for every landing type (previously local only) and for external landings too: tracking.js, kclient.js and kclient.php pass the visitor's landing time (_lt) on the tracker's signed transition link, and click.php synthesizes the pair on its own row. New landing_offer streams default to 'After the click' (existing streams unchanged), both options carry plain-language captions in the editor, click details show landing shown / offer transition / time-to-offer, and all new UI ships in 7 languages. Roles (issue #6): permission levels from the Users modal are now enforced server-side for non-admins across all six resources — none blocks everything including simple lists, read blocks every write action — and the previously open generate/delete_api_key (any logged-in user could mint a write key under the admin account) are admin-only. Campaigns additionally gain real per-campaign scoping: Full / Read only / Own + Selected / Selected / None, with an owner_user_id column (migration 42, legacy campaigns backfilled to the first admin), list/report/log/dashboard/trends filtering through a shared scope resolver, and a campaign assignment picker in the Users modal. Pinned by the expanded report_metrics_test (57 checks), the new lp_transition_timing_test (31 HTTP checks) and the resource_access_test matrix (52 checks).
